question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

chart.command: jyotish read --date 2001-03-12 --time 10:10:25 --tz Asia/Kolkata --lat 28.1989 --lon 76.617 --accuracy exact --node mean --seed 0 --depth astrologer --question 'How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?' --place 'Rewari, Haryana' --as-of 2026-10-21 --writer-model claude-opus-5-5 --writer-effort medium

summary.text: For career, the Sun, lord of the 4th, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th, join in the 10th, forming Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga and Budhaditya yoga from the lagna [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja][rule:yoga.budhaditya]. The house, lord, karaka, varga and panchanga votes for career all come out in favour, though the 10th itself has the lowest house strength of the career houses and its lord Saturn is below its required strength [vote:career.house][vote:career.lord][vote:career.karaka][vote:career.varga][vote:career.panchanga]. In its nakshatra chain the Sun, the main career significator, sits in PurvaBhadra, a nakshatra of Jupiter, and is activated by the current major period of Jupiter [chain:career.karaka].
summary.timing_line: Best window for career by the engine's timing score: 2029-10-23 to 2032-06-23 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Venus, score 0.84), strongest from 2030-05-01 to 2030-09-22 (score 0.89). Window to avoid: 2028-11-17 to 2029-08-08 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Ketu, score 0.47).
summary.timing_note: These are periods the engine scores as favourable for career; it does not predict when you will act.

claims.text: The house vote is for career: the 2nd (Gemini, 8.93 rupas), the 11th (Pisces, 8.23), the 6th (Libra, 8.22) and the 11th from the Sun (Sagittarius, 8.95) are strong, even though the 10th itself, in Aquarius, is the weakest at 4.51 rupas [vote:career.house].

The panchanga vote is for career: Mars, lord of the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th, the 2nd and 7th from the Moon and the 10th from the Sun with a strength ratio of 1.3, and the Moon, lord of the vara, rules the 10th from the Moon and the 6th from the Sun at 1.27 [vote:career.panchanga].

The karaka vote is for career: the Sun (enemy's sign, ratio 1.23) and Mercury (neutral, 1.19) both sit in the 10th, Venus is exalted in the 11th at 1.33, and Saturn in the 1st is in a friend's sign but at 0.69 [vote:career.karaka].

The lord vote is for career: Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in Pisces in the 11th with a strength ratio of 1.33, Mars, lord of the 7th, is in its own sign Scorpio at 1.3, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd, sits in the 10th at 1.19, while Saturn, lord of the 10th, is in a friend's sign in the 1st at only 0.69 [vote:career.lord].

The varga vote in the dasamsa (D10) is for career: Mars in Capricorn scores highest and agrees with its own-sign placement in the birth chart, Saturn in Capricorn adds support, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus add a little, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

Saturn, lord of the 10th, follows a sign chain from Taurus in the 1st through Venus exalted in Pisces to Jupiter in Taurus, ending in the Jupiter–Venus loop, and it is not activated by either current period [chain:career.lord].

The karaka vote is for marriage: Venus is exalted in Pisces in the 11th at a strength ratio of 1.33, Jupiter is in the 1st in an enemy's sign at 1.22, and Mercury is in the 10th, neutral, at 1.19 [vote:marriage.karaka].

The lord vote is for marriage: Mars, lord of the 7th, is in its own sign Scorpio in the 7th with a strength ratio of 1.3, Venus, lord of the 1st, is exalted in Pisces at 1.33, and Jupiter, lord of the 11th and 8th, sits in the 1st in an enemy's sign at 1.22 [vote:marriage.lord].
The varga vote in the navamsa (D9) is for marriage: Saturn in Capricorn scores highest, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus each add a little, and the Sun in Gemini is neutral [vote:marriage.varga].

Mars, lord of the 7th, is its own final dispositor in its sign chain in Scorpio, sits in the Mars–Mercury loop of its nakshatra chain through a mutual nakshatra exchange with Mercury, and is activated by the current sub-period of Mercury [chain:marriage.lord].
